decisionsTitle: The home page shows the listing's own cards (amending §717 and the redesign plan's decision 10)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-11**, comparing the home page (§717) with «Alergări» on QA: «totuși aici pe homepage ar trebui să văd fix tipul de carduri din alergări, ca să reutilizăm...».

**Decision — one card, two pages.** The home page's three run sections — «Următoarea alergare», «Alergările săptămânale», «Evenimente speciale» — draw the listing's own cards. One new component, `ListingCard` (`src/modules/events/ui/ListingCard.tsx`), is the listing's choice made once: a series (two dates or more) is `SeriesCard`, a single date is `EventCard` with its series' dates (§486). The listing's grid (`events/page.tsx` → `ListingBody`) now draws its cards through it, its markup unchanged, and the home page's sections draw theirs through it too (`src/modules/home/ui/RunSection.tsx`), so a change to a card shows on both pages and the two cannot drift apart. Each card carries what it carries on «Alergări»: the kind, series and partner chips («Alergare de grup», «Concurs», «Săptămânal», «Ediție specială»), the title as the link stretched over the card (§486), the summary with its picture (§73), the facts, the weather at the start (§416), «Următoarele date», the registration line and button (§409), and «Descrierea completă a evenimentului».

**What each section hands its cards** — what the listing hands them, from the read the home page already had (`cachedUpcomingEvents`, §717). «Următoarea alergare» is the soonest run's one date on the single-date card, wearing «Săptămânal» when it is a date of a weekly series (`seriesLookup` over the whole list). The weekly and special sections are one card per series as `homeSections` already chose them (§709: at most six, soonest first, a series whose every date ahead is cancelled no card), each card the series' dates. The forecast is one `forecastsForEvents` call for every card, the next run's included. No new query: the cards' own reads are the listing's — the same cached availability entry per race card whose registration is open (§409), which also holds the static page until the door's next instant, as it does the listing.

**The layout.** Each section keeps its heading, its line and «Vezi toate alergările»; the cards sit in the listing's grid (`CARD_GRID_SX`: one column on a phone, two from `md`, three from `xl`) with the listing's rise-in. §717's sideways scroll-snap strip on a phone goes: the listing's card is measured for the listing's column (§366, `EventFacts`' width budget at 320 pixels), and an 82-per-cent card in a strip would be narrower than any width it was measured at. The next run is one card of that grid, at the listing's width.

**What went (amends §717, part A, and the plan's decision 10).** The home page's own card components — `NextRunCard`, `RunCardGrid`, `RunTag`, `RoundArrow`, `card-sx.ts` — with the cover slot on each card (the mountain mark for an event without a cover), the kind's tag over it, the next-run card's forecast words and «Apus la …», and the picture ladder's `homeCard` column; the catalogues lose `Home.nextRun.sunset` and `Home.weekly.next`. Decision 10 (a round arrow on the home page's cards only) is now the owner's answer: no round arrow anywhere, §319's text door everywhere; the plan's row (`design/redesign-plan.ts`, the catalogues) and `docs/REDESIGN.md` say so. The hero keeps `HomePicture` and its empty slot. The event's cover (phase 2, §709) is now drawn by no public page: the listing's card never drew it, and the home page's cards were its only reader.

**The design page.** «Mostre» → «Pagina principală · Hero, RunSection» draws the hero and the three sections from the sample rows (`design/home-fixtures.ts`), the cards being the listing's.

**Refused.** Copying the listing's markup into a home card (two cards to keep in step, the opposite of the ask). Restyling the listing's card for the home page (the listing renders unchanged; a change to the card is the listing's and shows on both). The listing lead's frame and race-week countdown on «Următoarea alergare» (the lead is the featured race while the next run is the soonest run, so a weekly run would wear «Evenimentul principal»; the countdown needs the deadlines read the home page does not make). Keeping the scroll-snap strip (above).

**Open for the club.** Whether the listing's card should draw the event's cover (phase 2) — it would then show on both pages at once; and whether six cards a section is still right now that each card is taller.

**Verification.** Unit `home/home-listing-cards.test.ts` (a section's card is, byte for byte, the markup `SeriesCard` or `EventCard` draws from the same row, in both languages; `ListingCard` is the component the listing's grid draws with; the next run's date carries its series; `readHomeContent` hands each section the listing's rows and asks the forecast once; a section with no card draws nothing), `home/home-page.test.ts` (one `main`, one `h1`, the three headings, the hero's empty slot alone, every card's door, no round arrow and no kind tag, the old files gone), `home/home-sections-render.test.ts`, `appearance/look-accent.test.ts`, `design/*`, `i18n/*`, `events/listing-card.test.ts`, `events/featured-card.test.ts`, `media/ladder.test.ts`, `public-cache/static-public-routes.test.ts`; e2e `home-page.spec.ts` (every card of a run section a list item with its title link and its door at 44 pixels, no round arrow, no kind tag) with `listing-cards.spec.ts`, against a production build.
changelogLine: - **The home page shows the cards of «Alergări»** — «Următoarea alergare», the weekly runs and the special events are drawn with the listing's very cards (chips, summary and picture, facts, weather, dates, registration, «Descrierea completă a evenimentului»), in the listing's grid; the home page's own cards, their empty cover slots and the round arrow are gone. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given the home page's three run sections — «Următoarea alergare», «Alergările săptămânale», «Evenimente speciale» — when they render, then every card is the listing's own (`ListingCard`: `SeriesCard` for a series, `EventCard` for a date, the same markup «Alergări» draws from the same row, a date of a weekly series with its «Săptămânal» chip) in the listing's grid — one column on a phone, two from `md`, three from `xl` — its title link and «Descrierea completă a evenimentului» at least 44 pixels tall, with no cover slot, kind tag or round arrow of the home page's own; this replaces criterion 212's sideways scroll-snap strip (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `home/home-listing-cards.test.ts`, `home/home-page.test.ts`; e2e `home-page.spec.ts`.

Given `/admin/design` → «Mostre», when it renders, then «Pagina principală» draws `Hero` and the three `RunSection`s — the components the site's root renders, their cards the listing's own — from sample rows that name no person, the hero's heading a paragraph so the page keeps its one `h1`; this replaces criterion 145's `NextRunCard` and `RunCardGrid` (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `home/home-page.test.ts`, `design/design-page.test.ts`.

batchLine: the home page shows the listing's own cards
